event.title: Search Underway for Missing North Carolina Woman in Grenada
event.canonical_title: Search Underway for Missing North Carolina Woman in Grenada
event.summary: Elizabeth Waddell, a 44-year-old woman from Cary, North Carolina, has gone missing while vacationing in Grenada. She was last seen on a beach in the capital city on Wednesday and did not return to her accommodation. Authorities are actively searching for her, and her family is asking for assistance and prayers for her safe return.

timeline.title: Search Underway for Missing North Carolina Woman in Grenada
timeline.summary: Elizabeth Waddell, a 44-year-old woman from Cary, North Carolina, has been reported missing after last being seen swimming at Grand Anse Beach in Grenada. Her family is actively seeking assistance in locating her following her disappearance during a vacation.
